Committee: Ways and Means General Fund
Sponsor: Alexander
Analyst: Julie Knight
Date: 02/03/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 193 as amended and reported by the Committee on Ways and Means General Fund proposes a local constitutional amendment that, if ratified, would allow an elected official in the City of Bessemer in Jefferson County to participate in the Employees Retirement System (ERS) of Alabama.  This bill would increase the proclamation expense of the Governor, paid from the State General Fund, by an estimated $100,000 for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2021; this bill would not otherwise affect state funding or the ERS state employer contribution rate.
Steve Clouse, Chair
Ways and Means General Fund
